candidate_practices.name: Make the information interface part of the problem
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify how information becomes available and connect that interface to their proposed framework.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: interface details can explain why an otherwise familiar task requires a different algorithm or guarantee.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a broad practicality claim with the available query types, observable inputs, or access restrictions; state which design choice accommodates them.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not foreground access restrictions when they neither constrain the method nor distinguish the research question.

support.specific_example: Statements are query-accessed and variable-length; the extension addresses approximate queries and total slate length.
The value-query versus practical demand-query mismatch motivates a combined-query learner and auction.
Collective assessment and coordination must use quantities inferable from observed data before intervention.
History-dependent target substitution is linked to current/proposed-state information and reversible or non-reversible sampler compatibility.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Formal access models, implementation costs, and whether the claimed compatibility or practical correspondence holds.

candidate_practices.name: Identify where expensive computation changes
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts locate a computational change at a specific stage rather than reporting scalability alone.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: locating the change makes the claimed quality–cost relationship easier to interrogate.
candidate_practices.application: Name the expensive operation, specify where it is refined, relaxed, bypassed, or avoided, and attach the relevant quality and resource claims.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not imply that omitted computation is harmless when the method only reports aggregate savings without locating their source.

support.specific_example: A co-clustering property motivates recursive low-rank refinement ending in a bijection with reported linear space and log-linear runtime.
SPLIT permits greedy decisions near leaves and reports speedups with negligible performance loss.
Adaptive inference ordering bypasses difficult infilling subproblems; reported Sudoku accuracy rises from below 7% to about 90%.
Directly targeting informative synthetic examples replaces generate-then-prune work, with separately reported sample and iteration savings.

contrasts.contrast: Small-model reasoning uses MCTS and large-scale synthesis; small parameter count alone does not establish computational savings.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Complexity assumptions, total computational accounting, quality measurements, and whether the proposed mechanism explains the savings.

candidate_practices.name: Attach guarantees to their operative regime
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect formal results to model classes, initialization, regularization, or supported component and knowledge regimes.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: adjacent conditions help readers distinguish a usable theorem from an unrestricted headline.
candidate_practices.application: Write each guarantee as condition–result–qualification; instantiate broad framework claims with the supported objects or components.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Avoid adding arbitrary restrictions to genuinely unrestricted results; include the conditions that actually determine scope.

support.specific_example: Random-feature ensemble equivalence is qualified by width, parameter budget, and exact ridgeless versus approximate small-ridge behavior.
Polynomial-delay listing uses singleton knowledge; counterexamples expose incompleteness for general background knowledge.
Predefined-component pipelines are instantiated with three choices at each of three stages, alongside a false-positive-control claim.
The gradient-descent low-tubal-rank bias is tied to small random initialization, with simulations illustrating predicted dynamics.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact assumptions, error definitions, convergence bounds, proof scope, and whether simulations test the stated theoretical quantities.

candidate_practices.name: Match evaluation granularity to the new capability
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts introduce evaluation resources or measures corresponding to interaction, capability decomposition, task graphs, or generation duration.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: changing the measurement unit can make a newly targeted capability assessable; the resource can itself be a contribution.
candidate_practices.application: Identify what existing evaluation misses, then name the new unit or axis of measurement and the resource that enables it.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not add capability slices or bespoke metrics when existing validated measures already resolve the research question.

support.specific_example: A multiturn benchmark accompanies LLM-judged task/interactivity results and separately reported satisfaction/time results from a 201-judge study.
Environment and capability coverage accompanies a high-level versus manipulation diagnosis and GPT-4o's 28.9% average.
Graph-composed tasks receive subtask and graph-level evaluation; dataset human acceptance is reported separately.
Reportedly uninformative existing evaluations motivate LibriSpeech-Long and quality measurements across generation length and time.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Metric validity, aggregation, evaluator protocols, resource construction, and whether the measurements substantiate the capability diagnoses.

candidate_practices.name: Separate structural evidence from its explanation
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts name structural assumptions, analyzed factors, or representation changes alongside methods or behavioral findings, with differing explanatory strength.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: identifying the intermediate object can sharpen an explanation without treating a hypothesis as established causation.
candidate_practices.application: State the structural object and its evidential status—assumption, analyzed factor, observed pattern, or interpretation—before connecting it to the outcome.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent a mechanism when only outcome measurements are available.

support.specific_example: Distinct smooth feature subsets motivate Laplacian-smooth partitioning and condition the subset-identification guarantee.
A generalization transition accompanies representational merger, interpreted as finite-automaton construction.
Abrupt test-accuracy improvement and uninformative early losses accompany gradual block-circulant feature learning in RFM and analogous neural features.
Feature dimension and neighborhood size are analyzed alongside HOA and NFR layers; the extraction does not establish each layer's separate effect.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Representation measurements, causal identification, formal status of algorithmic interpretations, and component-to-factor mappings.

candidate_practices.name: Choose comparisons that resolve distinct claims
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts use comparisons for different questions: capability change, multiple generative objectives, or alternative policy investments.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: specifying the comparison's purpose can prevent a single ranking from substituting for the actual research decision.
candidate_practices.application: For each headline claim, name the relevant comparator and outcome; preserve best-case, task-specific, and non-directional qualifications.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not manufacture a common score or cost comparison for alternatives whose objectives or budgets are not commensurate.

support.specific_example: MATH performance is reported as 58.8% to 90.0% and relative to o1-preview; AIME separately reports 8/15 problems.
TarFlow distinguishes likelihood results from sample quality/diversity comparisons with diffusion models.
Prediction is assessed against bureaucratic-capacity expansion using mathematical models and a German unemployment case study, without a stated winner.

contrasts.contrast: The framework abstract names a product-evaluation experiment but provides no comparative outcome; a numerical victory cannot be reconstructed.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Comparator identities, budgets, protocols, metric definitions, and the conditions determining comparative conclusions.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Present mathematical discovery through a reformulation and a concrete discovered object.
unusual_but_useful.application: Name the hard-constrained problem, explain its differentiable probabilistic reformulation, and identify the resulting constructions and exact problem variant.
unusual_but_useful.limit: The two reported six-colorings concern an off-diagonal variant; neither original-constraint validity nor historical priority is independently established here.

unusual_but_useful.application: State the capacity-related interpretation of ensemble predictive variance separately from conventional uncertainty.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Keep this interpretation within the studied theoretical regime.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs a missing-method gap and a numerical victory.
discarded_generalizations.reason: A focused question, explanatory case study, or decision framework can organize the contribution; missing results cannot be invented.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: A paper should contain only one contribution type.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Method, resource, evaluation, and theoretical extensions can form coherent combinations.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Reported improvements establish practical user benefit.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Query reductions do not establish cognitive-load reductions, and dataset acceptance does not establish agent usefulness.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: These patterns explain Oral selection or validate ORAL as a universal framework.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Selected abstract extractions provide neither selection evidence nor a framework comparison.

source_checks_needed.issue: Check exact off-diagonal scope and priority wording; the lesson's suggestion of preserved constraints exceeds demonstrated abstract evidence.
General-background incompleteness is a boundary result, not necessarily the primary motivation for listing.
Check explicit factor-to-layer linkage and what outperforming in privacy protection means.
Verify whether infinite generalization and automaton construction are proved, observed, or interpreted.
Check whether unbiasedness and near-zero variance refer to samples, estimators, or asymptotic quantities.
Clarify 'from scratch,' o1 versus o1-preview, and the basis of the student-percentile comparison.
Check pipeline significance versus selected-feature significance and the exact controlled error probability.
Preserve the distinction between available samples/dataset and prospective code/model releases.
